lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, evidence inspection, bounded decisions, useful next action, and honest recovery

findings.observation: The production flow keeps exact source, four decisions, a corrected confirmed value, dismissal, separate approval, unknown result, reconciliation, and retry in one ordered workspace. No uncoached recruiter was observed explaining confirmation, approval, unknown, and verified.
findings.user_impact: An experienced operator can recover without duplicate work, while a first-time recruiter may still misread an authority transition.
findings.recommendation: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough and require a plain-language explanation of every authority boundary.
findings.verification: The recruiter completes TS-CORE-01 without prompting and makes no false effect or outcome claim.

findings.observation: The original Web gate offered approval after a required competing-process fact was dismissed. The backend rejected it. The repaired UI now withholds approval and explains that no action runs.
findings.user_impact: Recruiters no longer encounter a dead-end approval control after making a legitimate dismiss decision.
findings.recommendation: Keep the action-bound required-assertion regression and add the same check for future action types.
findings.verification: Every action exposes authority only when its exact required assertions are confirmed.

strengths: The exact candidate words remain beside recruiter-controlled interpretation and correction.
A dismissed action-bound fact ends with an honest no-authority explanation.
A changed preview invalidates approval, and an unknown result blocks execution retry until reconciliation.
Cancelled and failed reads keep the last verified state readable and offer the smallest safe retry.
missing_evidence: Timed day-later return after prior verified state.
open_questions: Would a first-time recruiter understand why dismissing one required fact blocks this exact proposal without assuming the evidence itself was deleted?
